comments.body:
## Summary

Fixes two race conditions where lock operations were called unconditionally regardless of the c.batched flag.

## Problems

### 1. HTTPAttach (line 437)
c.lock.Unlock() was called unconditionally, even when c.batched = true (lock never acquired), causing a data race.

### 2. WaitForExit (lines 665-667)
c.lock.Unlock() and c.lock.Lock() were called unconditionally, but the initial lock is only acquired when !c.batched (line 623), causing deadlock or undefined behavior.

## Solution

Guard all lock/unlock operations with c.batched checks to match the initial lock acquisition pattern.

## Testing

- Code compiles successfully
- Passes make lint
- Follows existing Podman lock patterns
